notes: One board: px4_sitl_default with the SIH quadrotor. A parameter it does not have cannot be set in the older release or converted to in the newer one, and a translation that checks whether a parameter exists finds it missing; such results are not-in-build, not pass or fail.
The values are read after the newer release has started, so anything the firmware does with them after the import is part of the result.
The import-order runs add stored values to the storage by hand, in a given order, to show what the real import does when the storage has both a parameter and the one it is converted to.
